description:
The role:

AlphaSights' Platform Engineers work hard to make sure we’re performant, highly available and resilient to failures. As a DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for planning, building and maintaining our core AWS infrastructure and our CI/CD pipelines and toolset. 

We're looking for people who are interested in designing and executing solutions to a very high standard, comfortable working across multiple technologies, and learn quickly when new ones are introduced. We care more about your engineering skill versus your deep knowledge of a particular tool, provider or technology.

What you’ll do:

  • Create solutions that enable our engineering teams to deploy code quickly, reliably and securely
  • Ensure the availability, scalability, performance and security of our cloud infrastructure
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot application and infrastructure related issues quickly and effectively
  • Provision cloud resources based on capacity, computing and security requirements
  • Always have best security practices top of mind, employing zero trust and principle of least privilege across all critical systems and resources
  • Work in tandem with development teams to manage and execute DevOps and Infrastructure initiatives
  • Regularly evaluate and research alternative solutions to improve internal DevOps processes
  • Continuously evaluate and refine the monitoring of our critical infrastructure and applications

Who you are:

  • You probably have a degree in a STEM subject, but we’re happy to work with people who perfected their craft via a different route.
  • 3+ years experience in demonstrating competency and positive results in a DevOps, SRE or Infrastructure Engineering role.
  • 3+ years experience managing and demonstrating competency with AWS infrastructure, including EKS, RDS, S3, and others as well as professional experience with CI/CD tooling and concepts.
  • Experience working at a similar level in an Engineering team, and looking to take your career to the next level. We’re looking for people who have incredible potential.
  • Proven track record – You’ve made a demonstrable impact in your previous roles, standing out from your peers. 
  • Highly driven and proactive – you relentlessly and independently push through hurdles and drive towards excellent outcomes.
  • Meticulous – you hold high standards and have an obsessive attention to detail.

Learn more about our tech organisation here.

Don’t worry if your experience or background doesn’t match all of these areas, we believe a broad spectrum of experience provides great perspective on solving problems in new and innovative ways and we’d love to hear from you.

AlphaSights is an equal opportunity employer.

*THIS IS A REMOTE POSITION EXCLUSIVELY FOR CURRENT BRAZILIAN RESIDENTS.
